description: Candidate frozen corpus for realistic deep-review precision, recall, noise and coverage evaluation. All repositories are unacquired candidates: commits, tree digests and range endpoints must be filled by a human from public history. This file is not a measured result.

review_policy.notes: Each subject is labelled independently by two humans before either sees Ozagia findings. A third human adjudicates disagreements. Synthetic fixtures remain separate regression checks and are never pooled into a realistic-corpus score.

repositories.reason: Small WSGI framework with tests, configuration and request-handling security surfaces; useful for change-range review and test-coverage checks.
Widely used HTTP client in maintenance mode; exercises redirect, TLS configuration, timeout and resilience review.
Active sync/async HTTP client; exercises concurrency, connection-pool and failure-mode findings.
Active test framework with deep architecture and plugin surfaces; held out from rule tuning to test generalisation.
Performance-sensitive Rust CLI; exercises resource bounds, traversal and output-path review.
Small Rust filesystem tool; exercises small-repository precision, error handling and filesystem failure modes.
Go terminal tool with concurrency and I/O paths; exercises Go collectors and interactive failure modes.
Go web framework with middleware and routing security surfaces; held out from rule tuning.
Maintenance-mode JavaScript framework; exercises routing, middleware and documentation/API review.
TypeScript HTTP client; exercises typed public API, retries, timeouts and resilience review.
C++ formatting library; exercises memory/lifetime, performance and header-only API review.
Large C++ test framework; exercises architecture, test infrastructure and cross-language collector coverage.
